verses.sloka: तां तु रामकथां श्रुत्वा वैदेही वानरार्षभात् ।उवाच वचनं सान्त्वमिदं मधुरया गिरा ।। ५.३५.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ tu rāmakathāṁ śrutvā vaidehī vānarārṣabhāt ।uvāca vacanaṁ sāntvamidaṁ madhurayā girā ।। 5.35.1।।।।

translations.english: On hearing about Rama from the bull among vanaras, thus spoke Vaidehi politely in a sweet voice:
translations.hindi: — औ 5 १ पाठान्तरे--“दृढब्रतो ॥* सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुर्णचन्द्रनिभानना । हनूसन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः

verses.sloka: क्व ते रामेण संसर्गः कथं जानासि लक्ष्मणम् ।वानराणां नराणां च कथमासीत् समागमः ।। ५.३५.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: kva te rāmeṇa saṁsargaḥ kathaṁ jānāsi lakṣmaṇam ।vānarāṇāṁ narāṇāṁ ca kathamāsīt samāgamaḥ ।। 5.35.2।।।।

translations.english: "Where did you come in contact with Rama? How did you assess Lakshmana? How did an alliance of vanaras and humans take place?
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! तुम्हारा यह कंथन कि, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का मन अ्रन्य किसी । झर नहीं जाता और वे शोकाकुल बने रहते हें; विष मिले हुए प्रमृत के | समान है

verses.sloka: यानि रामस्य लिङ्गानि लक्ष्मणस्य च वानर ।तानि भूयः समाचक्ष्व न मां शोकः समाविशेत् ।। ५.३५.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāni rāmasya liṅgāni lakṣmaṇasya ca vānara ।tāni bhūyaḥ samācakṣva na māṁ śokaḥ samāviśet ।। 5.35.3।।।।

translations.english: "O vanara tell me all about the identification marks of Rama and Lakshmana again so that grief does not enter my mind.
translations.hindi: मनुष्य भले ही बड़े ऐश्वर्य का उपभोग करता हो अथवा महादारुण दुःख ही क्यों न भोगता हो, किन्तु मोत, उस मनुष्य के गले में रसी बांध कर उसको भ्रपनी ओर खींचती ही रहती है

verses.sloka: कीदृशं तस्य संस्थानं रूपं रामस्य कीदृशम् ।कथमूरू कथं बाहू लक्ष्मणस्य च शंस मे ।। ५.३५.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: kīdṛśaṁ tasya saṁsthānaṁ rūpaṁ rāmasya kīdṛśam ।kathamūrū kathaṁ bāhū lakṣmaṇasya ca śaṁsa me ।। 5.35.4।।।।

translations.english: "What does Rama look like? And Laksmana? How are his thighs, arms? Tell me".
translations.hindi: है वानरश्रेष्ठ ! प्राणियों की भवितव्यता निश्चय ही भ्रमिट है । देखो, लक्ष्मण, में और श्रीरामचन्द्रजी कैसे-कैसे दुःख झेल रहे हैँ

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।ततो रामं यथात्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ५.३५.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu vaidehyā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।tato rāmaṁ yathāttvamākhyātumupacakrame ।। 5.35.5।।।।

translations.english: Questioned thus by Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod started describing Rama's physique as it is.
translations.hindi: शोकस्यास्य कदा पारं राघवोऽधिगमिष्यति । प्लवमानः परिशान्तो हतनौ: सागरे यथा ॥। ५ नौका के टूट जाने पर समुद्र में तेरते हुए ग्रौर थके हुए मनुष्य की तरह, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी प्रयत्न करके भी, न मालूम कब, इस शोकसागर के पार लगेंगे ?

verses.sloka: जानन्ती बत दिष्ट्या मां वैदेहि परिपृच्छसि ।भर्तुः कमलपत्राक्षि संस्थानं लक्ष्मणस्य च ।। ५.३५.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: jānantī bata diṣṭyā māṁ vaidehi paripṛcchasi ।bhartuḥ kamalapatrākṣi saṁsthānaṁ lakṣmaṇasya ca ।। 5.35.6।।।।

translations.english: "O Vaidehi with eyes like lotus petals although you know your husband's and Lakshmana's form and distinguishing marks, it is my good fortune that you asked me (to describe them).
translations.hindi: रावण के भाई विभीषण ने इस बात के लिए यत्न किया था प्रौर श्रनुनय विनय भी किया था कि, रावण मुझे श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को लौटा दे, परन्तु उस दुष्ट ने उनका कहना न माना

verses.sloka: यानि रामस्य चिह्नानि लक्ष्मणस्य च यानि वै ।लक्षितानि विशालाक्षि वदतः शृणु तानि मे ।। ५.३५.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāni rāmasya cihnāni lakṣmaṇasya ca yāni vai ।lakṣitāni viśālākṣi vadataḥ śṛṇu tāni me ।। 5.35.7।।।।

translations.english: "O largeeyed lady I will describe those distinguishing marks of Rama and Lakshmana Listen.
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! तुम जा कर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी से शीघ्रता करने के लिए कह्‌ देना । क्योंकि जव तक यह वषं पूरा नहीं होता, तभी तक मेरे जीने की भ्रवषि है

verses.sloka: रामः कमलपत्राक्षः सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरः ।रूपदाक्षिण्यसम्पन्नः प्रसूतो जनकात्मजे ।। ५.३५.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ sarvasattvamanoharaḥ ।rūpadākṣiṇyasampannaḥ prasūto janakātmaje ।। 5.35.8।।।।

translations.english: "O daughter of Janaka Rama with eyes like lotus petals is a person born with a delightful form, richly endowed with indescribable charm and politeness.
translations.hindi: इस वर्ष का यह दसवां माह चल रहा है श्रौर इसकी समाप्ति में भ्रब केवल दो मास श्रौर रह गए हैं । क्रूर रावण ने मेरे जीने के लिए यही श्रवषि ही बाँघी है

verses.sloka: तेजसा ऽ ऽदित्यसङ्काशः क्षमया पृथिवीसमः ।बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या यशसा वासवोपमः ।। ५.३५.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tejasā ' 'dityasaṅkāśaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ ।bṛhaspatisamo buddhyā yaśasā vāsavopamaḥ ।। 5.35.9।।।।

translations.english: "He vies with the Sun in effulgence, with earth in forbearance, with Brihaspati in intelligence, and in fame with Indra.

verses.sloka: रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य स्वरजनस्याभिरक्षिता ।रक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य धर्मस्य च परन्तपः ।। ५.३५.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣitā jīvalokasya svarajanasyābhirakṣitā ।rakṣitā svasya vṛttasya dharmasya ca parantapaḥ ।। 5.35.10।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is a protector of the entire world of living beings not to speak of his own people. He is a protector of his own race. He guards righteousness. He is a scorcher of enemies.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को मेरा लौटा देना, रावण को पसंद नहीं । क्योंकि उसके ` सिर पर उसकी मौत खेल रही है झौर युद्धक्षेत्र में मौत रावण के वघ का अवसर ढूढ़ रही है

verses.sloka: रामो भामिनि लोकस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता ।मर्यादानां च लोकस्य कर्ता कारयिता च सः ।। ५.३५.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmo bhāmini lokasya cāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā ।maryādānāṁ ca lokasya kartā kārayitā ca saḥ ।। 5.35.11।।।।

translations.english: "O beautiful lady Rama is a protector of the four classes of society (Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaisya and Sudra) in the world. He follows codes of conduct and makes others follow them.
translations.hindi: हे कपे ! यह बात विभोपण की बड़ो बेटी कला ने, प्रपनी माता की प्रेरणा से, मुझे कही थी

verses.sloka: अर्चिष्मानर्चितो ऽत्यर्थं ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः ।साधूनामुपकारज्ञः प्रचारज्ञश्च कर्मणाम् ।। ५.३५.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: arciṣmānarcito 'tyarthaṁ brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ ।sādhūnāmupakārajñaḥ pracārajñaśca karmaṇām ।। 5.35.12।।।।

translations.english: "He is luminous and highly revered. He observes vow of selfcontrol. He is steadfast and recognises services rendered by sages. He is aware of the rites and the ways of administration.
translations.hindi: हेवानरश्रेष्ठ ! मुझे इस बात का पूरा भरोसा है कि, श्री रामचन्द्रजी मझे शीघ्र मिलेंगे । क्योंकि, मेरी ग्रन्तरात्मा शुद्ध है प्रीर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी में बहुत गुण हे

verses.sloka: राजविद्याविनीतश्च ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता ।श्रुतवान् शीलसम्पन्नो विनीतश्च परन्तपः ।। ५.३५.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rājavidyāvinītaśca brāhmaṇānāmupāsitā ।śrutavān śīlasampanno vinītaśca parantapaḥ ।। 5.35.13।।।।

translations.english: "He is welltrained in statecraft. He is devoted to brahmins. Endowed with an excellent conduct, he is learned in scriptures and a scorcher of enemies.
translations.hindi: उत्साहः पोरुषं सत्वसानुशस्य छतन्नता। £ ra है हाई वे | क, विकमश्च प्रभावश्च सन्ति वानर राघवे

verses.sloka: यजुर्वेदविनीतश्च वेदविद्भिः सुपूजितः ।धनुर्वेदे च वेदेषु वेदाङ्गेषु च निष्ठितः ।। ५.३५.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: yajurvedavinītaśca vedavidbhiḥ supūjitaḥ ।dhanurvede ca vedeṣu vedāṅgeṣu ca niṣṭhitaḥ ।। 5.35.14।।।।

translations.english: "He is versed in Yajurveda and is respected by Vedic scholars. He has mastered Dhanurveda and other Vedas and auxillary Vedas as well.

verses.sloka: विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवः शुभाननः ।गूढजत्रुः सुताम्राक्षो रामो देवि जनैः श्रुतः ।। ५.३५.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: vipulāṁso mahābāhuḥ kambugrīvaḥ śubhānanaḥ ।gūḍhajatruḥ sutāmrākṣo rāmo devi janaiḥ śrutaḥ ।। 5.35.15।।।।

translations.english: "O godlike lady Rama has broad shoulders, strong arms, conchshaped neck and an auspicious countenance. With his fleshy round arms and copperyred eyes, he is renowned in all the worlds.
translations.hindi: न ७ रक्‍्यस्तुलयित व्यसने: पुरुषर्षभः । अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञा शक्रस्येव पुलोमजा ॥। १५ १ पाठान्तरे--“कम्याऽनला ।” २ एक संस्करण में ये दो श्लोक श्रौर हैं :-- अविन्ध्यो नाम मेधावी विद्वान्राक्षसपुङ्गवः । श्रुतिमाङशीलवान्वृद्धो रावणस्य सुसम्मतः ॥ रामक्षयमनुप्राप्तं रक्षसां प्रत्यचोदयत्‌ । न च तस्य स दुष्टात्मा शुणोति वचनं हितम्‌ ।। र पतिः ब र ३ उन श्रीरामचंद्रजी के साथ उन समस्त दुःखदाई राक्षसों की बराबरी नहीं हो सकती । शची देवी जिस प्रकार इंद्र का प्रभाव जानती हें; उसी प्रकार में श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का प्रभाव जानती हूं

verses.sloka: दुन्दुभिस्वननिर्घोषः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान् ।समः समविभक्ताङ्गो वर्णं श्यामं समाश्रितः ।। ५.३५.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: dundubhisvananirghoṣaḥ snigdhavarṇaḥ pratāpavān ।samaḥ samavibhaktāṅgo varṇaṁ śyāmaṁ samāśritaḥ ।। 5.35.16।।।।

translations.english: "His tone is resonant like drums, he has a beautiful, dark, shining complexion. He has symmetrical, well proportioned limbs. He is neither too tall nor too short.
translations.hindi: हे वरानने ! श्रयवा में स्वयं ही श्रमी तुमको राक्षसों के झत्याचारो खे छुड़ाए देता हूँ । हे भ्रनिंदिते ! तुम मेरी पीठ पर बे ,लो

verses.sloka: त्रिस्थिरस्त्रिप्रलम्बश्च त्रिसमस्त्रिषु चोन्नतः ।त्रिताम्रस्त्रिषु च स्निग्धो गम्भीरस्त्रिषु नित्यशः ।। ५.३५.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tristhirastripralambaśca trisamastriṣu connataḥ ।tritāmrastriṣu ca snigdho gambhīrastriṣu nityaśaḥ ।। 5.35.17।।।।

translations.english: "He has three stiff parts, three long parts, three even parts, three shining parts, elevated in three parts, has three raised parts, his body has lines in three parts and is of coppery reddish colour in three parts. He has a majestic look.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार श्रीरामचंद्रजी के विषय में बातें करती हुईं दुश्चियारी श्रौर घासू बहाती हुई सीता से, हनुमानजी कहने लगे

verses.sloka: त्रिवलीवांस्त्र्यवनतश्चतुर्व्यङ्गस्त्रिशीर्षवान् ।चतुष्कलश्चतुर्लेखश्चतुष्किष्कुश्चतुः समः ।। ५.३५.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: trivalīvāṁstryavanataścaturvyaṅgastriśīrṣavān ।catuṣkalaścaturlekhaścatuṣkiṣkuścatuḥ samaḥ ।। 5.35.18।।।।

translations.english: "He has three folds in the skin of his neck and belly, is depressed in the middle of his soles and the nipples, undersized at four placesthe neck, penis, shanks and back, has three spirals on his head, has four lines under his thumb, has four lines on his forehead, he is a person with four cubits in height and symmetrical arms, cheeks and thighs.

verses.sloka: चतुर्दशसमद्वन्द्वश्चतुर्दंष्ट्रश्चतुर्वर्गतिः ।महोष्ठहनुनासश्च पञ्चस्निग्धो ऽष्टवंशवान् ।। ५.३५.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: caturdaśasamadvandvaścaturdaṁṣṭraścaturvargatiḥ ।mahoṣṭhahanunāsaśca pañcasnigdho 'ṣṭavaṁśavān ।। 5.35.19।।।।

translations.english: "He is a person with his pairs of eyebrows, nostrils, eyes, ears, lips, nipples, elbows, wrists, knees, testicles, loins, arms, legs and buttocks in good symmetry he has four sharp teeth. He walks in different gaits like a lion, leopard, elephant and bull as occasion demands he has sharp nose, charming lips and jaws. He has smooth hair, eyes, skin, teeth and feet and his eight parts of his body namely back, trunk, limbs, fingers, toes, eyes and testicles are long.

verses.sloka: दशपद्मो दशबृहत् त्रिभिर्व्याप्तो द्विशुक्लवान् ।षडुन्नतो नवतनुस्त्रिभिर्वाप्नोति राघवः ।। ५.३५.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: daśapadmo daśabṛhat tribhirvyāpto dviśuklavān ।ṣaḍunnato navatanustribhirvāpnoti rāghavaḥ ।। 5.35.20।।।।

translations.english: "Ten limbs of the body resemble lotuses. He has proportionate limbs. He is known by the virtue of his spledour, fame and glory. Both his teeth and eyes are fair. Six parts of his body are elevated, nine parts of his body are fine and sharp. He pursues spiritual merit, worldly comfort and sensual delight in three periods of the dayforenoon, midday and evening. He always adopts the righteous way of life.
translations.hindi: तुमको अपनी पीठ पर बैठा कर में समुद्र पार हो जाऊंगा । (यह मत जानना कि, मैं ऐसा न कर सकू्‌गा । ) मुझमें इतनी शक्ति है कि, में रावण समेत लक्का को भी ले जा सकता हूँ

verses.sloka: सत्यधर्मपरः श्रीमान् संग्रहानुग्रहे रतः ।देशकालविभागज्ञः सर्वलोकप्रियंवदः ।। ५.३५.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: satyadharmaparaḥ śrīmān saṁgrahānugrahe rataḥ ।deśakālavibhāgajñaḥ sarvalokapriyaṁvadaḥ ।। 5.35.21।।।।

translations.english: "He is ever established in truth and righteousness. He is prosperous and desires to accumulate wealth in order to shower favour on others. He knows the right use of time and place in discharging his duties. He has endeared himself to all by his words.
translations.hindi: हे मैथिली ! में भ्राज ही तुमको श्रीराम जन्द्रजी के पास प्रस्रवण गिरि पर वसे ही पहुँचा दुंगा, जैसे अग्निदेव, इन्द्र के पास होम की हुई सामग्री पहुँचा देते हें

verses.sloka: भ्राता च तस्य द्वैमात्रः सौमित्रिरपराजितः ।अनुरागेण रूपेण गुणैश्चैव तथाविधः ।। ५.३५.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātā ca tasya dvaimātraḥ saumitriraparājitaḥ ।anurāgeṇa rūpeṇa guṇaiścaiva tathāvidhaḥ ।। 5.35.22।।।।

translations.english: "His invincible brother Saumitri born of a different mother is a replica of Rama in affection, charm and virtues.

verses.sloka: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकौ ।विचिन्वन्तौ महीं कृत्स्नामस्माभिरभिसङ्गतौ ।। ५.३५.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau naraśārdūlau tvaddarśanasamutsukau ।vicinvantau mahīṁ kṛtsnāmasmābhirabhisaṅgatau ।। 5.35.23।।।।

translations.english: "While earnestly searching for you all over the earth both tigers among men came in contact with us.
translations.hindi: देवि ! महाबलवान्‌ श्रोरामचंद्रजी तुम्हें देखने की भ्रभिलाषा से उत्साहित हो, पवंतराज के शिखर पर इंद्र की तरह बेठे हुए हे

verses.sloka: त्वामेव मार्गमाणौ तौ विचरन्तौ वसुन्धराम् ।ददर्शतुर्मृगपतिं पूर्वजेनावरोपितम् ।। ५.३५.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvāmeva mārgamāṇau tau vicarantau vasundharām ।dadarśaturmṛgapatiṁ pūrvajenāvaropitam ।। 5.35.24।।।।

translations.english: "While both of them were wandering, searching for you all over the earth they saw Sugriva, the lord of animals who had been thrown out of kingship by his elder brother and was living on the mountain Rshyamuka frightened of him.
translations.hindi: हे सुन्दरी देवी ! अब तुम सोच-विचार मत करो प्रौर मेरी पीठ पर बेठ लो भोर श्रीरामचंद्रजी से मिलने के लिए वेसे ही इच्छा करो, जैसे रोहिणी देवी चंद्रमा से, शची देवी इंद्र से और सुवचंला देवी सूयं से मिलने की इच्छा किया करती हे । तुम मेरी पीठ पर सवार हो लो, में आकाशमार्ग से समुद्र क्के पार हो जाऊंगा

verses.sloka: ऋश्यमूकस्य पृष्ठे तु बहुपादपसङ्कुले ।भ्रातुर्भयार्तमासीनं सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम् ।। ५.३५.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: ṛśyamūkasya pṛṣṭhe tu bahupādapasaṅkule ।bhrāturbhayārtamāsīnaṁ sugrīvaṁ priyadarśanam ।। 5.35.25।।।।

translations.english: "While both of them were wandering, searching for you all over the earth they saw Sugriva, the lord of animals who had been thrown out of kingship by his elder brother and was living on the mountain Rshyamuka frightened of him.

verses.sloka: वयं तु हरिराजं तं सुग्रीवं सत्यसङ्गरम् ।परिचर्यास्महे राज्यात् पूर्वजेनावरोपितम् ।। ५.३५.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: vayaṁ tu harirājaṁ taṁ sugrīvaṁ satyasaṅgaram ।paricaryāsmahe rājyāt pūrvajenāvaropitam ।। 5.35.26।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva, king of vanaras who is committed to defend truth has been deposed from the kingdom by his elder brother. We keep attending on him.

verses.sloka: ततस्तौ चीरवसनौ धनुःप्रवरपाणिनौ ।ऋश्यमूकस्य शैलस्य रम्यं देशमुपागतौ ।। ५.३५.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastau cīravasanau dhanuḥpravarapāṇinau ।ṛśyamūkasya śailasya ramyaṁ deśamupāgatau ।। 5.35.27।।।।

translations.english: "Both the princes clad in bark robes and armed with powerful bows reached the beautiful location of Rshyamukha mountain.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार में उस पार से यहां ग्राया हू, उसी प्रकार तुमको श्रपनी पीठ पर लिए हुए, निश्चय हो में आकाश मार्ग से उस पार चला जाऊंगा

verses.sloka: स तौ दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रौ धन्विनौ वानरर्षभः ।अवप्लुतो गिरेस्तस्य शिखरं भयमोहितः ।। ५.३५.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tau dṛṣṭvā naravyāghrau dhanvinau vānararṣabhaḥ ।avapluto girestasya śikharaṁ bhayamohitaḥ ।। 5.35.28।।।।

translations.english: "On seeing the tigers among men armed with bows, Sugriva, the bull among vanaras jumped from the mountain deluded with fear and reached the peak.
translations.hindi: कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी के इन प्रद्भुत वचनों को सुन, सीता हरित और , विस्मित हो हनुमानजी से बोलीं

verses.sloka: ततः स शिखरे तस्मिन् वानरेन्द्रो व्यवस्थितः ।तयोः समीपं मामेव प्रेषयामास सत्वरम् ।। ५.३५.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa śikhare tasmin vānarendro vyavasthitaḥ ।tayoḥ samīpaṁ māmeva preṣayāmāsa satvaram ।। 5.35.29।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter the lord of vanaras staying on the mountain top quickly sent me to meet both of them.
translations.hindi: हे हनुमान ! तुम मुझे लिए हुए इतनी दूर कैसे जा सकोगे । है हरियूथप ! (वानरों के सरदार) तुम्हारी इस बात से तो तुम्हारा वानरपना प्रकट होता है

verses.sloka: तावहं पुरुषव्याघ्रौ सुग्रीववचनात् प्रभू ।रूपलक्षणसम्पन्नौ कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः ।। ५.३५.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāvahaṁ puruṣavyāghrau sugrīvavacanāt prabhū ।rūpalakṣaṇasampannau kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ ।। 5.35.30।।।।

translations.english: At Sugriva's bidding I approached with joined palms those two tigers among men, two lords endowed with charming form and auspicious marks.
translations.hindi: हे वानरोत्तम ! फिर तुम इतने छोटे शरीर वाले होकर, किस तरह मुझे मेरे नरेन्द्र पति के पास पहुंचा सकते हो ?

verses.sloka: तौ परिज्ञाततत्त्वार्थौ मया प्रीतिसमन्वितौ ।पृष्ठमारोप्य तं देशं प्रापितौ पुरुषर्षभौः ।। ५.३५.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tau parijñātatattvārthau mayā prītisamanvitau ।pṛṣṭhamāropya taṁ deśaṁ prāpitau puruṣarṣabhauḥ ।। 5.35.31।।।।

translations.english: "I recognised the true status of both the mighty men who were filled with joy, placed them on my back, and reached the mountaintop.

verses.sloka: निवेदितौ च तत्त्वेन सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ।तयोरन्योन्यसंलापाद्भृशं प्रीतिरजायत ।। ५.३५.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: niveditau ca tattvena sugrīvāya mahātmane ।tayoranyonyasaṁlāpādbhṛśaṁ prītirajāyata ।। 5.35.32।।।।

translations.english: "I reported faithfully about both the highsouled men to Sugriva. As they got to know each other through conversation a fast friendship developed between them.

verses.sloka: ततस्तौ प्रीतिसम्पन्नौ हरीश्वरनरेश्वरौ ।परस्परकृताश्वासौ कथया पूर्ववृत्तया ।। ५.३५.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastau prītisampannau harīśvaranareśvarau ।parasparakṛtāśvāsau kathayā pūrvavṛttayā ।। 5.35.33।।।।

translations.english: Then the king of the monkeys and the king of men, full of joy, consoled each other with the account of their past.
translations.hindi: बह्‌ बोले--हे कृष्णनयनी ! तुम प्रभो मेरे बल ग्रौर प्रभाव को नहीं जानतो । इसो से ऐसा कह रही हो । ग्रतः ग्रथ तुम, जैसा कि मेरा कामरूपी इति साचन्त्य हनमास्तदा प्लबगसत्तसः । ५2 पे es SOT i बल दर्शयामास वंदेह्या: स्वं रूपसरिमदन:

verses.sloka: ततः स सान्त्वयामास सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।स्त्रीहेतोर्वालिना भ्रात्रा निरस्तमुरुतेजसा ।। ५.३५.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sāntvayāmāsa sugrīvaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।strīhetorvālinā bhrātrā nirastamurutejasā ।। 5.35.34।।।।

translations.english: "Then Rama, consoled Sugriva who was dethroned and abandoned on acount of a woman by his brother Vali, endowed with great prowess.

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वन्नाशजं शोकं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।लक्ष्मणो वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ५.३५.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastvannāśajaṁ śokaṁ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।lakṣmaṇo vānarendrāya sugrīvāya nyavedayat ।। 5.35.35।।।।

translations.english: "Then Lakshmana spoke to the lord of vanaras, Sugriva about your loss and the grief caused to Rama, who is adept in accomplishing difficult deeds with ease.
translations.hindi: उस समय कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी मेरुपर्वंत की तरह लंबे-चौड़े श्रौर दहकती हुई आग को तरह कान्तिमान हो, सीताजो के समान खड़े हो ग

verses.sloka: स श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्तु लक्ष्मणेनेरितं वचः ।तदा ऽ ऽसीन्निष्प्रभो ऽत्यर्थं ग्रहग्रस्त इवांशुमान् ।। ५.३५.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śrutvā vānarendrastu lakṣmaṇeneritaṁ vacaḥ ।tadā ' 'sīnniṣprabho 'tyarthaṁ grahagrasta ivāṁśumān ।। 5.35.36।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard the words of Lakshmana, the king of vanaras became extremely lustreless like the Sun overshadowed by the planet Rahu.
translations.hindi: उस समय पर्वताकार, लालमुख, महाबलवान्‌ ग्रौर वस्र के समान दांतों भोर नखों को धारण किए हुए भयङ्कर ख्पधारी हनमानजी ने जानकोजी से यह्‌-कहा

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वद्गात्रशोभीनि रक्षसा ह्रियमाणया ।यान्याभरणजालानि पातितानि महीतले ।।। ५.३५.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastvadgātraśobhīni rakṣasā hriyamāṇayā ।yānyābharaṇajālāni pātitāni mahītale ।।। 5.35.37।।।।

translations.english: The vanara leaders joyfully brought to Rama all the bundles of ornaments that had dropped to the ground from your limbs as the demon bore you away, and showed them, though they did not know your whereabouts.

verses.sloka: तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरियूथपाः ।संहृष्टा दर्शयामासुर्गतिं तु न विदुस्तव ।। ५.३५.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi rāmāya ānīya hariyūthapāḥ ।saṁhṛṣṭā darśayāmāsurgatiṁ tu na vidustava ।। 5.35.38।।।।

translations.english: The vanara leaders joyfully brought to Rama all the bundles of ornaments that had dropped to the ground from your limbs as the demon bore you away, and showed them, though they did not know your whereabouts.

verses.sloka: तानि रामाय दत्तानि मयैवोपहृतानि च ।स्वनवन्त्यवकीर्णानि तस्मिन् विगतचेतसि ।। ५.३५.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāni rāmāya dattāni mayaivopahṛtāni ca ।svanavantyavakīrṇāni tasmin vigatacetasi ।। 5.35.39।।।।

translations.english: "I collected the ornaments and gave them to Rama. He lost his senses on seeing the jingling ornaments scattered.

verses.sloka: तान्यङ्के दर्शनीयानि कृत्वा बहुविधं तव ।तेन देवप्रकाशेन देवेन परिदेवितम् ।। ५.३५.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tānyaṅke darśanīyāni kṛtvā bahuvidhaṁ tava ।tena devaprakāśena devena paridevitam ।। 5.35.40।।।।

translations.english: "The divine self who is effulgent like god wailed in many ways placing the beautiful ornaments on his lap.
translations.hindi: हे महाकपे ! प्रब मेने तुम्हारा बल-पराकम भली भांति जान लिया । तुम्हारी गति पवन के समान और तुम्हारा तेज अग्नि के समान अद्भुत है

verses.sloka: पश्यतस्तानि रुदतस्ताम्यतश्च पुनः पुनः।प्रादीपयन् दाशरथेस्तानि शोकहुताशनम् ।। ५.३५.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: paśyatastāni rudatastāmyataśca punaḥ punaḥ।prādīpayan dāśarathestāni śokahutāśanam ।। 5.35.41।।।।

translations.english: "Rama looked at them and wept clasping them again and again in grief which inflamed like fire.
translations.hindi: हे कपिश्रेष्ठ ! नहीं तो क्या कोई मामूली वानर भी इस लाँचने के प्रयोग्य समुद्र को लांघ कर यहाँ ग्रा सकता है

verses.sloka: शयितं च चिरं तेन दुःकार्तेन महात्मना ।मयापि विविधैर्वाक्यैः कृच्छ्रादुत्थिपितः पुनः ।। ५.३५.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: śayitaṁ ca ciraṁ tena duḥkārtena mahātmanā ।mayāpi vividhairvākyaiḥ kṛcchrādutthipitaḥ punaḥ ।। 5.35.42।।।।

translations.english: "Rama, the great self, immersed in sorrow lay down on the ground. I also consoled him with great difficulty and helped him to get up.
translations.hindi: मैं जानती हूँ कि, तुममें बहुत दूर चलने की श्रौर मुझको ग्रपनो पीठ पर चढ़ाकर ले जाने की शक्ति है, किन्तु शी घ्रतापुर्वेक कार्य सिद्ध होने के सम्बन्ध में मुझे स्वयं भी सोच-विचार लेना श्रावश्यक है

verses.sloka: तानि दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्दर्शयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः ।राघवः सहसौमित्रिः सुग्रीवे संन्यवेदयत् ।। ५.३५.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāni dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurdarśayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ।rāghavaḥ sahasaumitriḥ sugrīve saṁnyavedayat ।। 5.35.43।।।।

translations.english: "Longarmed Rama along with Lakshmana looked at them again and again and gave them to the care of Sugriva.

verses.sloka: स तवादर्शनादार्ये राघवः परितप्यते ।महता ज्वलता नित्यमग्निनेवाग्निपर्वतः ।। ५.३५.४४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tavādarśanādārye rāghavaḥ paritapyate ।mahatā jvalatā nityamagninevāgniparvataḥ ।। 5.35.44।।।।

translations.english: "O divine lady on account of your separation he is ever blazing like a mountain of fire (Samvartaka).
translations.hindi: जब तुम मुझे लिए हुए ग्राकाशमागं से बड़े वेग से जाने लगोगे, तब में कदाबित्‌ भयभीत हो, समुद्र में गिर पडो प्रौर यदि समुद्र के मगर मच्छ मुशे पकड़ कर खा गए, तब तुम क्या करोगे ?

verses.sloka: त्वत्कृते तमनिद्रा च शोकश्चिन्ता च राघवम् ।तापयन्ति महात्मानमग्न्यागारमिवाग्नयः ।। ५.३५.४५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvatkṛte tamanidrā ca śokaścintā ca rāghavam ।tāpayanti mahātmānamagnyāgāramivāgnayaḥ ।। 5.35.45।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is burning like a furnace by (three fires) sleeplessness, grief and intense anxiety just as the three sacred fires keep a firesanctuary intensely heated.

verses.sloka: तवादर्शनशोकेन राघवः प्रविचाल्यते ।महता भूमिकम्पने महानिव शिलोच्चयः ।। ५.३५.४६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tavādarśanaśokena rāghavaḥ pravicālyate ।mahatā bhūmikampane mahāniva śiloccayaḥ ।। 5.35.46।।।।

translations.english: "On account of sorrow caused by not being able to see you, Rama of Raghu dynasty is shaken up like a lofty mountain is shaken by earthquake.
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुबिनाशन ! प्रतः में तुम्हारे साथ न जा सकूगी। क्योंकि एक जन किसी स्त्री को उडाए लिए जा रहा है, यह देख, निश्चय ही राक्षसगण तुम पर सन्देह करेंगे

verses.sloka: काननानि सुरम्याणि नदीः प्रस्रवणानि च ।चरन्न रतिमाप्नोति त्वामपश्यन्नृपात्मजे ।। ५.३५.४७।।।।
verses.transliteration: kānanāni suramyāṇi nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca ।caranna ratimāpnoti tvāmapaśyannṛpātmaje ।। 5.35.47।।।।

translations.english: "Oh princess unable to see you, Rama has found no joy in roaming delightful forests, rivers and streams.
translations.hindi: प्रौर मुझे लिए हुए जाते देख, दुरात्मा रावण की श्राज्ञा पा, भयंकर विक्रमशाली राक्षस लोग तुम्हारा पीछा करेंगे

verses.sloka: स त्वां मनुजशार्दूलः क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यति राघवः ।समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं जनकात्मजे ।। ५.३५.४८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tvāṁ manujaśārdūlaḥ kṣipraṁ prāpsyati rāghavaḥ ।samitrabāndhavaṁ hatvā rāvaṇaṁ janakātmaje ।। 5.35.48।।।।

translations.english: "Oh daughter of Janaka after killing Ravana, along with his friends and relatives Rama, the tiger among men, will meet you.

verses.sloka: सहितौ रामसुग्रीवावुभावकुरुतां तदा ।समयं वालिनं हन्तुं तव चान्वेषणं तथा ।। ५.३५.४९।।।।
verses.transliteration: sahitau rāmasugrīvāvubhāvakurutāṁ tadā ।samayaṁ vālinaṁ hantuṁ tava cānveṣaṇaṁ tathā ।। 5.35.49।।।।

translations.english: "(Having become friends) Rama and Sugriva together reached an agreement to kill Vali and search for you.
translations.hindi: फिर राक्षसों के पास तो तरह-तरह के हथियार होंगे शौर तुम आकाश में निरस्त्र होगे । ऐसी दशा होने पर, मेरी रक्षा करनी तो जहां-तहाँ, तुम धागे जा भी कंसे सकोगे

verses.sloka: ततस्ताभ्यां कुमाराभ्यां वीराभ्यां स हरीश्वरः ।किष्किन्धां समुपागम्य वाली युद्धे निपातितः ।। ५.३५.५०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastābhyāṁ kumārābhyāṁ vīrābhyāṁ sa harīśvaraḥ ।kiṣkindhāṁ samupāgamya vālī yuddhe nipātitaḥ ।। 5.35.50।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter both the princes together arrived at Kishkinda and killed Vali, king of vanaras in a combat.
translations.hindi: हे कपिश्रेष्ठ | जब उन क्रूरकर्मा भयंकर राक्षसों का तुम सामना करोगे, तब भयभात हो, में अवश्य तुम्द्दारी पीठ से नीचे गिर पडू गी

verses.sloka: ततो निहत्य तरसा रामो वालिनमाहवे ।सर्वर्क्षहरिसङ्घानां सुग्रीवमकरोत् पतिम् ।। ५.३५.५१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato nihatya tarasā rāmo vālinamāhave ।sarvarkṣaharisaṅghānāṁ sugrīvamakarot patim ।। 5.35.51।।।।

translations.english: "Then Rama quickly killed Vali in a combat and made Sugriva the lord of all troops of vanaras and bears.
translations.hindi: हे कपिश्रेष्ठ ! फिर यदि उन भयंकर और महाबली राक्षसों ने युद्ध में तुम्हें जीत ही लिया ग्रथवा तुम हार कर भागे श्रौर में गिर पड़ो प्रौर उन पाप्री राक्षसों के हाथ पड़ गई, तो क्या होगा ?

verses.sloka: रामसुग्रीवयोरैक्यं देव्येवं समजायत ।हनुममन्तं च मां विद्धि तयोर्दूतमिहागतम् ।। ५.३५.५२।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasugrīvayoraikyaṁ devyevaṁ samajāyata ।hanumamantaṁ ca māṁ viddhi tayordūtamihāgatam ।। 5.35.52।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Illustrious lady In that manner alliance was established between Rama and Sugriva. Know me to be Hanuman, arrived here as their messenger.

verses.sloka: स्वराज्यं प्राप्य सुग्रीवः समानीय हरीश्वरान् ।त्वदर्थं प्रेषयामास दिशो दश महाबलान् ।। ५.३५.५३।।।।
verses.transliteration: svarājyaṁ prāpya sugrīvaḥ samānīya harīśvarān ।tvadarthaṁ preṣayāmāsa diśo daśa mahābalān ।। 5.35.53।।।।

translations.english: "Having obtained his kingdom Sugriva despatched the vanara leaders to all ten directions (to search for you).
translations.hindi: ग्रथवा वे राक्षस तुम्हारे हाथ से मुझे छीन कर ले गए या मुझे मार ही डाला तब क्या होगा? क्योंकि, युद्ध में कोन जीते, कौन हारे, इसका पहले से कुछ भी निश्चय नहीं हो सकता

verses.sloka: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महौजसा ।अद्रिराजप्रतीकाशाः सर्वतः प्रस्थिता महीम् ।। ५.३५.५४।।।।
verses.transliteration: ādiṣṭā vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa mahaujasā ।adrirājapratīkāśāḥ sarvataḥ prasthitā mahīm ।। 5.35.54।।।।

translations.english: "Following Sugriva's orders, the powerful monkey leaders huge as the Himalayas, king of mountains went all over the earth (searching).
translations.hindi: फिर यदि राक्षसों की डाँट-डपट से मेरे प्राण ही निकल गए तो, हे कपिश्रेष्ठ ! तुम्हारा सारा परिश्रम व्यथं ही होगा

verses.sloka: ततस्ते मार्गमाणा वै सुग्रीववचनातुराः ।चरन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः ।। ५.३५.५५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste mārgamāṇā vai sugrīvavacanāturāḥ ।caranti vasudhāṁ kṛtsnāṁ vayamanye ca vānarāḥ ।। 5.35.55।।।।

translations.english: "Following Sugriva's orders, we, the monkeys, since then are moving about searching the entire earth eager to find you or to carry out Sugriva's orders.
translations.hindi: यथपि तुम निस्सन्देह भ्रकेले सब राक्षसों को मार डाल सकते हो; तयापि यदि तुमने राक्षसों को मार डाला, तो तुम्हारे इस कार्य से श्रीराम- चन्द्रजी के यश में तो बट्टा लग ही जायया

verses.sloka: अङ्गदो नाम लक्ष्मीवान् वालिसूनुर्महाबलः ।प्रस्थितः कापिशार्दूलस्त्रिभागबलसंवृतः ।। ५.३५.५६।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgado nāma lakṣmīvān vālisūnurmahābalaḥ ।prasthitaḥ kāpiśārdūlastribhāgabalasaṁvṛtaḥ ।। 5.35.56।।।।

translations.english: The prosperous and mighty son of Vali, a tiger among monkeys named Angada, set out together with a third of the army.
translations.hindi: इसमें एक दोष यह्‌ भी है कि यदि राक्षसों ने मझे पकड़ पाया घौर लंका में ले झए तो फिर बे मुझे किसी ऐसी जगह छिपा देंगे कि, जहाँ कोई वानर या श्रीरामचन्द्रजी मशे देख ही न पावे

verses.sloka: तेषां नो विप्रनष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे ।भृशं शोकपरीतानामहोरात्रगणा गताः ।। ५.३५.५७।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ no vipranaṣṭānāṁ vindhye parvatasattame ।bhṛśaṁ śokaparītānāmahorātragaṇā gatāḥ ।। 5.35.57।।।।

translations.english: "We wasted many nights and days immersed in disappointment (for not being able to find you) and we missed our path in the great Vindhya mountain.
translations.hindi: अत: मर पीछे तुबन जा इतना श्रम किया है सा सब व्यथ चला जायया) स्तः यही ठीक होगा कि, तुम श्रोरामचन्द्रजी को साय लेकर यहाँ झाको

verses.sloka: ते वयं कार्यनैराश्यात् कालश्यातिक्रमेण च ।भयाच्च कपिराजस्य प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं व्यवस्थिताः ।। ५.३५.५८।।।।
verses.transliteration: te vayaṁ kāryanairāśyāt kālaśyātikrameṇa ca ।bhayācca kapirājasya prāṇāṁstyaktuṁ vyavasthitāḥ ।। 5.35.58।।।।

translations.english: "We decided to give up our lives due to disappointment, transgression of the time limit fixed for us and fear of the monkey lord (fear of facing the king without finding you).
translations.hindi: महाबलवान्‌ श्रोरामचन्द्रजी का और उनके सव भाइयों का तथा तुम्हारे वानरराज सुग्रीव के कुल का भी जीवन मेरे ही ऊपर निर्भर है

verses.sloka: विचित्य वनदुर्गाणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च ।अनासाद्य पदं देव्याः प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यताः ।। ५.३५.५९।।।।
verses.transliteration: vicitya vanadurgāṇi giriprasravaṇāni ca ।anāsādya padaṁ devyāḥ prāṇāṁstyaktuṁ samudyatāḥ ।। 5.35.59।।।।

translations.english: "We decided to give up our lives since we were unable to see the feet of the queen (Sita) even after searching the forest fortresses and the (banks of) mountain streams.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा प्रायोपविष्टांश्च सर्वान् वानरपुङ्गवान् ।भृशं शोकार्णवे मग्नः पर्यदेवयदङ्गदः ।। ५.३५.६०।।।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā prāyopaviṣṭāṁśca sarvān vānarapuṅgavān ।bhṛśaṁ śokārṇave magnaḥ paryadevayadaṅgadaḥ ।। 5.35.60।।।।

translations.english: Seeing all the vanara leaders resolved to die, Angada, plunged in a sea of sorrow, grieved aloud over your disappearance, the slaying of Vali, the death of Jatayu, and our own resolve to fast unto death.
translations.hindi: हे वानर ! तुम्हारे साथ चलने में एक यह भी आपत्ति ह कि, में पतिब्रता हुं--प्रत: श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को छोड़, किसी अन्य पुरष का दरार ( अपनी इच्छा से ) नहीं छ सकती !

verses.sloka: तवनाशं च वैदेहि वालिनश्च वधं तथा ।प्रायोववेशमस्माकं मरणं च जटायुषः ।। ५३.५.६१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tavanāśaṁ ca vaidehi vālinaśca vadhaṁ tathā ।prāyovaveśamasmākaṁ maraṇaṁ ca jaṭāyuṣaḥ ।। 53.5.61।।।।

translations.english: Seeing all the vanara leaders resolved to die, Angada, plunged in a sea of sorrow, grieved aloud over your disappearance, the slaying of Vali, the death of Jatayu, and our own resolve to fast unto death.
translations.hindi: मझे जो रावण के शरीर का स्पर्श हुआ सो बरजोरी हुआ । क्योंकि उस समय में कर ही वया सकती थी । में विवश थी श्रोर उस समय मुझ पतिव्रताः को बचाने वाला भी कोई न था !

verses.sloka: तेषां नः स्वामिसन्देशान्निराशानां मुमूर्षताम् ।कार्यहेतोरिवायातः शकुनिर्वीर्यवान् महान् ।। ५.३५.६२।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ naḥ svāmisandeśānnirāśānāṁ mumūrṣatām ।kāryahetorivāyātaḥ śakunirvīryavān mahān ।। 5.35.62।।।।

translations.english: "When we were disappointed (in tracing you) and were at the point of death having been commanded by the king (that whosoever overstays would be killed) a gigantic powerful bird appeared to fulfil our task.

verses.sloka: गृध्रराजस्य सोदर्यः सम्पातिर्नाम गृध्रराट् ।श्रुत्वा भ्रातृवधं कोपादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३५.६३।।।।
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrarājasya sodaryaḥ sampātirnāma gṛdhrarāṭ ।śrutvā bhrātṛvadhaṁ kopādidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 5.35.63।।।।

translations.english: "That king of vultures, Sampati was the brother of king of birds Jatayu. Hearing about the death of his younger brother Sampati felt distresed and spoke in anger:
translations.hindi: उन शत्रनाशकारी महात्मा श्रीरामचंद्रजी का पराक्रम मन छुना भी है ग्रीर देखा भी है । श्रतः में कह सकती हूं कि, युद्ध म क्या दवता, गन्वव क्या सर्प और क्या राक्षस--कोई भी उनका सामना नहीं कर सकता !

verses.sloka: यवीयान् केन म भ्राता हतः क्व च निपातितः ।एतदाख्यातुमिच्छामि भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमाः ।। ५.३५.६४।।।।
verses.transliteration: yavīyān kena ma bhrātā hataḥ kva ca nipātitaḥ ।etadākhyātumicchāmi bhavadbhirvānarottamāḥ ।। 5.35.64।।।।

translations.english: 'O best of vanaras by whom was my younger brother killed? Where was he dropped down? I wish you to tell me all about that.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे हे कॉपर १ EE शरन के समान | विक्रम वाले श्रीराम- | चन्द्रजी युद्धक्षेत्र में श्रपना अद्भुत घनुष हाथ में ले खड़े हो जाते है और | लक्ष्मण उनकी सहायता में सावधान रहते हे, तब किसकी मजाल है, जो उनके सामने खड़ा रह सके। भला वायु से बढ़ाई हुई झाग की लपटों के सामने भी कोई खड़ा रह सकता है

verses.sloka: अङ्गदो ऽकथयत्तस्य जनस्थानेः महद्वधम् ।रक्षसा भीमरूपेण त्वामुद्दिश्य यथातथम् ।। ५.३५.६५।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgado 'kathayattasya janasthāneḥ mahadvadham ।rakṣasā bhīmarūpeṇa tvāmuddiśya yathātatham ।। 5.35.65।।।।

translations.english: Angada faithfully told him of the great slaughter wrought in Janasthana on your account by the demon of dreadful form.
translations.hindi: जिस समय इन्रुमर्दनकारी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी लक्ष्मण सहित, मतवाले दिग्गज की तरह युद्धक्षेत्र में खड़े हो जाते हैं और प्रलयकालीन सूर्यं की तरह बाणों रूपी किरणों से झाग बरसाने लगते हे, उस समय उनके सामने ठह्रने की “किस में शक्ति है?

verses.sloka: जटायुषो वधं श्रुत्वा दुःखितः सो ऽरुणात्मजः ।त्वां शशंस वरारोहे वसन्तीं रावणालये ।। ५.३५.६६।।।।
verses.transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo vadhaṁ śrutvā duḥkhitaḥ so 'ruṇātmajaḥ ।tvāṁ śaśaṁsa varārohe vasantīṁ rāvaṇālaye ।। 5.35.66।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard about the death of Jatayu, O charming lady that Sampati Aruna's son felt sad and told us that you are at Ravana's palace.

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्पातेः प्रीतिवर्धनम् ।अङ्गप्रमुखास्तूर्णं ततः संप्रस्थिता वयम् ।। ५.३५.६७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sampāteḥ prītivardhanam ।aṅgapramukhāstūrṇaṁ tataḥ saṁprasthitā vayam ।। 5.35.67।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard Sampati's encouraging words all of us led by Angada departed immediately.

verses.sloka: विन्ध्यादुत्थाय संप्राप्ताः सागरस्यान्तमुत्तरम् ।त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहा हृष्टास्तुष्टाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ५.३५.६८।।।।
verses.transliteration: vindhyādutthāya saṁprāptāḥ sāgarasyāntamuttaram ।tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhā hṛṣṭāstuṣṭāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 5.35.68।।।।

translations.english: "The happy monkeys were satisfied. Enthusiastic about seeing you, they rose from the Vindhya mountain and reached the limit of the sea shore in the north.

verses.sloka: अङ्गदप्रमुखाः सर्वे वेलोपान्तमुपस्थिताः ।चिन्तां जग्मुः पुनर्भीतास्त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकाः ।। ५.३५.६९।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadapramukhāḥ sarve velopāntamupasthitāḥ ।cintāṁ jagmuḥ punarbhītāstvaddarśanasamutsukāḥ ।। 5.35.69।।।।

translations.english: Angada and all the other leaders, eager to see you, reached the seashore but, frightened, again sank into worry.

verses.sloka: तथा ऽहं हरिसैन्यस्य सागरं प्रेक्ष्य सीदतः ।व्यवधूय भयं ताव्रं योजनानां शतं प्लुतः ।। ५.३५.७०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tathā 'haṁ harisainyasya sāgaraṁ prekṣya sīdataḥ ।vyavadhūya bhayaṁ tāvraṁ yojanānāṁ śataṁ plutaḥ ।। 5.35.70।।।।

translations.english: "When the vanara army was feeling despondent at the sight of the ocean, I leaped across the sea, a hundred yojanas, pushing aside all my fear.

verses.sloka: लङ्का चापि मया रात्रौ प्रविष्टा राक्षसाकुला ।रावणश्च मया दृष्टस्त्वं च शोकपरिप्लुता ।। ५.३५.७१।।।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkā cāpi mayā rātrau praviṣṭā rākṣasākulā ।rāvaṇaśca mayā dṛṣṭastvaṁ ca śokapariplutā ।। 5.35.71।।।।

translations.english: "I entered at night the city of Lanka teeming with demons and saw Ravana and saw you immersed in sorrow.

verses.sloka: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथावृत्तमनिन्दिते ।अभिभाषस्व मां देवि दूतो दाशरथेरहम् ।। ५.३५.७२।।।।
verses.transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ yathāvṛttamanindite ।abhibhāṣasva māṁ devi dūto dāśaratheraham ।। 5.35.72।।।।

translations.english: "O sinless lady I have given you a faithful account. I am a messenger of Dasaratha's son. And you may speak now, O divine lady

verses.sloka: तं मां रामकृतोद्योगं त्वन्निमित्तमिहागतम् ।सुग्रीवसचिवं देवि बुध्यस्व पवनात्मजम् ।। ५.३५.७३।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ māṁ rāmakṛtodyogaṁ tvannimittamihāgatam ।sugrīvasacivaṁ devi budhyasva pavanātmajam ।। 5.35.73।।।।

translations.english: "O divine lady Know that I have come here for your cause carrying out the mission of Rama. I am Sugriva'a minister and son of the Windgod.

verses.sloka: कुशली तव काकुत्स्थः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ।गुरोराराधने युक्तो लक्ष्मणश्च सुलक्षणः ।। ५.३५.७४।।।।
verses.transliteration: kuśalī tava kākutsthaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।gurorārādhane yukto lakṣmaṇaśca sulakṣaṇaḥ ।। 5.35.74।।।।

translations.english: "Your lord Rama of Kakutstha race, supreme among wielders of weapons is doing well. So is venerable Lakshmana endowed with auspicious signs engaged in serving him.

verses.sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतो देवि भर्तुस्तव हिते रतः ।अहमेकस्तु संप्राप्तः सुग्रीववचनादिह ।। ५.३५.७५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vīryavato devi bhartustava hite rataḥ ।ahamekastu saṁprāptaḥ sugrīvavacanādiha ।। 5.35.75।।।।

translations.english: "O queen seeking the welfare of your Valiant husband I came here at the behest of Sugriva all alone.

verses.sloka: मयेयमसहायेन चरता कामरूपिणा ।दक्षिणा दिगनुक्रान्ता त्वन्मार्गविचयैषिणा ।। ५.३५.७६।।।।
verses.transliteration: mayeyamasahāyena caratā kāmarūpiṇā ।dakṣiṇā diganukrāntā tvanmārgavicayaiṣiṇā ।। 5.35.76।।।।

translations.english: "I can assume any form at my will. I searched for you without any help moving in the southern direction and reached this place .

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽहं हरिसैन्यानां त्वन्नाशमनुशोचताम् ।अपनेष्यामि सन्तापं तवाभिगमशंसनात् ।। ५.३५.७७।।।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā 'haṁ harisainyānāṁ tvannāśamanuśocatām ।apaneṣyāmi santāpaṁ tavābhigamaśaṁsanāt ।। 5.35.77।।।।

translations.english: "Fortunately for me I can finally dispel the fear of the vanara chiefs who are regretting your loss, by letting them know that you have been found.

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या हि मम न व्यर्थं देवि सागरलङ्घनम् ।प्राप्स्याम्यहमिदं दिष्ट्या त्वद्दर्शनकृतं यशः ।। ५.३५.७८।।।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā hi mama na vyarthaṁ devi sāgaralaṅghanam ।prāpsyāmyahamidaṁ diṣṭyā tvaddarśanakṛtaṁ yaśaḥ ।। 5.35.78।।।।

translations.english: "Oh queen luckily for me, crossing the ocean has not gone in vain. I am fortunate because I will attain fame of finding you.

verses.sloka: राघवश्च महावीर्यः क्षिप्रं त्वामभिपत्स्यते ।समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।। ५.३५.७९।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavaśca mahāvīryaḥ kṣipraṁ tvāmabhipatsyate ।samitrabāndhavaṁ hatvā rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam ।। 5.35.79।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Raghava will take you after killing Ravana, the king of demons along with his kith and kin.

verses.sloka: माल्यवान्नाम वैदेहि गिरीणामुत्तमो गिरिः ।ततो गच्छति गोकर्णं पर्वतं केसरी हरिः ।। ५.३५.८०।।।।
verses.transliteration: mālyavānnāma vaidehi girīṇāmuttamo giriḥ ।tato gacchati gokarṇaṁ parvataṁ kesarī hariḥ ।। 5.35.80।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Vaidehi there is a famous mountain called Malyavan. From there a monkey called Kesari went to mount Gokarna.

verses.sloka: स च देवर्षिभिर्दिष्टः पिता मम महाकपिः ।तार्थे नदीपतेः पुण्ये शम्बसादनमुद्धरत् ।। ५.३५.८१।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa ca devarṣibhirdiṣṭaḥ pitā mama mahākapiḥ ।tārthe nadīpateḥ puṇye śambasādanamuddharat ।। 5.35.81।।।।

translations.english: "He (Kesari) is said to be my father by the divine sages. He retrieved a piece of land in a holy spot of that sea shore and killed Sambasadana, a demon who was oppressing righteous people.

verses.sloka: तस्याहं हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि ।हनुमानिति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा ।। ५.३५.८२।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāhaṁ hariṇaḥ kṣetre jāto vātena maithili ।hanumāniti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā ।। 5.35.82।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili I was born in that land retrieved by the Windgod. I am known as Hanuman by virtue of my own action.

verses.sloka: विश्वासार्थं तु वैदेहि भर्तुरुक्ता मया गुणाः ।अचिराद् राघवो देवि त्वामितो नयिता ऽनघे ।। ५.३५.८३।।।।
verses.transliteration: viśvāsārthaṁ tu vaidehi bharturuktā mayā guṇāḥ ।acirād rāghavo devi tvāmito nayitā 'naghe ।। 5.35.83।।।।

translations.english: "In order to inspire confidence in you about me I have narrated the virtues of your husband. O sinless queen Rama will take you from here very soon".

verses.sloka: एवं विश्वासिता सीता हेतुभिः शोककर्शिता ।उपपन्नैरभिज्ञानैर्दूतं तमवगच्छति ।। ५.३५.८४।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ viśvāsitā sītā hetubhiḥ śokakarśitā ।upapannairabhijñānairdūtaṁ tamavagacchati ।। 5.35.84।।।।

translations.english: The griefstricken Sita trusted him by his logical presentation of reasons as well as identifications. She believed that he was a messenger (of Rama).

verses.sloka: अतुलं च गता हर्षं प्रहर्षेण च जानकी ।नेत्राभ्यां वक्रपक्ष्मभ्यां मुमोचानन्दजं जलम् ।। ५.३५.८५।।।।
verses.transliteration: atulaṁ ca gatā harṣaṁ praharṣeṇa ca jānakī ।netrābhyāṁ vakrapakṣmabhyāṁ mumocānandajaṁ jalam ।। 5.35.85।।।।

translations.english: Janaki experienced immeasurable happiness and shed tears of joy through her curved eyes.

verses.sloka: चारु तद्वदनं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम् ।अशोभत विशालाक्ष्या राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट् ।। ५.३५.८६।।।।
verses.transliteration: cāru tadvadanaṁ tasyāstāmraśuklāyatekṣaṇam ।aśobhata viśālākṣyā rāhumukta ivoḍurāṭ ।। 5.35.86।।।।

translations.english: Her face with large eyes with a tinge of red corners shone like the Moon released from Rahu.

verses.sloka: हनुमन्तं कपिं व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा ।अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम् ।। ५.३५.८७।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumantaṁ kapiṁ vyaktaṁ manyate nānyatheti sā ।athovāca hanūmāṁstāmuttaraṁ priyadarśanām ।। 5.35.87।।।।

translations.english: She realised that the monkey was none other than Hanuman. Then he looked at her who was pleasing to see and spoke again:

verses.sloka: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि ।किं करोमि कथं वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम् ।। ५.३५.८८।।।।
verses.transliteration: etatte sarvamākhyātaṁ samāśvasihi maithili ।kiṁ karomi kathaṁ vā te rocate pratiyāmyaham ।। 5.35.88।।।।

translations.english: "Mythili, everything I intended to say has been narrated to you. Calm yourself down. What shall I do? Or else, tell me what pleases you. I shall go back.

verses.sloka: हते ऽसुरे संयति शम्बसादने कपिप्रवीरेण महर्षिचोदनात् ।ततो ऽस्मि वायुप्रभवो हि मैथिलि प्रभावतस्तत्प्रतिमश्च वानरः ।। ५.३५.८९।।
verses.transliteration: hate 'sure saṁyati śambasādane kapipravīreṇa maharṣicodanāt ।tato 'smi vāyuprabhavo hi maithili prabhāvatastatpratimaśca vānaraḥ ।। 5.35.89।।

translations.english: "(My father) a mighty monkey killed Sambasadana in a battle on the command of a great seer. I am a vanara (born to a monkey) by the impact of the Windgod. I am equal to the Windgod in power." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
